title: Bunnings Panther
style: Phonk with half-time cowbell, dusty sub glide, cheeky Australian comedy groove, beatboxed percussion, and harmonic sung counterlines; verse stays sparse with talky lead and little whistled replies, pre-chorus strips to bass, snaps, and a tom pulse, chorus hits with stacked gang shouts and cricket-chant backing singers as instrumental color. Bridge drops to mouth percussion and airy harmonies, then the final chorus adds extra vocal layers, playful ad-libs, and a wide but gritty mix., comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Pull up in the ute, mate, quiet as a ghost
Chips in the glovebox, got sauce on my coat
Sneak past the servo, trying not to grin
Panther in the shadows with a snag on his chin

Oye, look at that stroll
Too slick for the road
He says "good day" low
Then vanishes, bro

[Pre-Chorus]
Tap-tap, heel to the floor
One more cheeky little score
From the beach to the bricks
He moves in little tricks

[Chorus]
Bunnings Panther, sneaky, sneaky
Bunnings Panther, muy tricky
Bunnings Panther, sneaky, sneaky
Mate, he gone in a blink-y

(oi, oi) (vamos)
(oi, oi) (rápido)

[Verse 2]
At the footy gate he’s smiling with the crowd
Thinks he’s just a local, but he’s prowling loud
Bird on the shoulder, magpie on the beat
He’s two-step sliding down a hot tin street

From the esky to the barbie, he’s a one-man show
Says "cheers, legend" then he dips so slow
He’s got that grin, yeah, that don’t quit
Like a possum on a mission with a little bit of wit

[Pre-Chorus]
Tap-tap, heel to the floor
One more cheeky little score
From the beach to the bricks
He moves in little tricks

[Chorus]
Bunnings Panther, sneaky, sneaky
Bunnings Panther, muy tricky
Bunnings Panther, sneaky, sneaky
Mate, he gone in a blink-y

(oi, oi) (vamos)
(oi, oi) (rápido)

[Bridge]
[Beatbox break]
Mm-kah, mm-kah, skrrt
Soft little hum, then it hurts
Hah, ahh, layered and bright
Panther in the dusk, out of sight

He’s laughing in the back of the van
With a pie in the hand and a plan in the hand

[Final Chorus]
Bunnings Panther, sneaky, sneaky
Bunnings Panther, muy tricky
Bunnings Panther, sneaky, sneaky
Mate, he gone in a blink-y

Bunnings Panther, cheeky, cheeky
Bunnings Panther, poco freaky
Bunnings Panther, sneaky, sneaky
Oi, that cat too slick-y

(oi, oi) (vamos)
(oi, oi) (Bunnings Panther)
